scout1.note: Payment success rate fell uniformly across Android (-9.5%), iOS (-9.2%), and web (-9.4%), pointing to a payment issue, but this slice cannot distinguish between UPI gateway outage and card BIN block.

scout2.note: Card payment success rate dropped sharply by 36.3% from 0.8361 to 0.5322, while success rates for UPI, netbanking, and wallet remained virtually unchanged.

scout3.note: Payment success rate fell by ~9.5% across all traffic sources (organic down 9.4%, paid down 9.5%, referral down 9.5%) while other rates remained flat, indicating a payment-stage issue that cannot be distinguished between UPI or card causes without payment method data.

scout4.note: Payment success rate fell 9.4% (0.8715 to 0.7893) while checkout and attempt rates remained flat, but this slice lacks payment method breakdown to distinguish UPI from card issues.

scout5.note: Daily blended conversion dropped noticeably from ~0.0680 on day 21 to ~0.0614-0.0624 from day 22 onwards, but overall blended data cannot isolate platform, payment method, or traffic source causes.

scout6.note: Overall conversion dropped 9.5% from 0.0683 to 0.0618, but the headline slice lacks segment breakdowns to isolate the root cause.

result.text: Conversion fell last week because of a card BIN block that prevented transactions from going through. This caused the conversion rate to drop from the baseline of 0.0683 to 0.0618, representing a -9.5% relative change.
